text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell in this session. I worked out each fix by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm everything passes.

- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added the daily rate instead of multiplying by it. It's now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3; I changed it to 5, which matches the comment and the tests.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It now returns the last `n` events, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`**: added the missing `Emma` book, so the sample has the three titles the tests expect.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` now turns the year into an integer, which also makes `age()` work.
- **`search.py`**: `normalize` was imported from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`); it now comes from `catalog.text`.

I didn't change any tests.
